title: Correlated Failure Matrix + Payload Diff Lens — prototype for multi-request root-cause mapping
creator: Ethan Park
description: Goal: Design a compact, scannable Correlated Failure Matrix that surfaces cross-request correlations (shared stack frames, common model variants, identical input prefixes) and an embedded Payload Diff Lens that highlights minimal textual/structured diffs between successful and failed calls. Intended for mid-to-senior engineers and SREs who triage production regressions in the Redwood Console. Scope: Matrix view as entrypoint from failed request list; shows clusters of related failures with correlation signals and confidence scores. Drill-in Payload Diff Lens shows token-level diffs, JSON path diffs for structured outputs, and quick-run replays with suggested mitigations. Lightweight timeline and linkouts to request traces, logs, and rerun tools are included. Non-goals: full session replay studio and probabilistic root-cause inference (we only show correlation signals and explainability hints).
comments: 2025-11-05 — Kickoff: synced with PM (Rhea) and Eng lead (Leo). Agreed to focus MVP on correlation signals that are cheap to compute (shared error signature, model variant, identical prompt prefix).

2025-11-06 — Sketch pass: matrix rows = failure clusters, columns = signal types (signature, variant, prefix, user-agent). Each cell shows proportion and a confidence badge. Added hover card concept to preview top 3 sample payloads.

2025-11-07 — Engineering review (Leo): token-level diffs can be supported via sampled token offsets from KV cache and request logs; very large payloads need truncation rules. Added 'sample + summarize' pattern to the design.

2025-11-08 — PM feedback (Rhea): add quick actions to each cluster (create incident, pin for alerting, schedule rollback). Prioritize 'create incident' and 'pin for alerting' for MVP; rollback action gated behind RBAC checks (defer).
2025-11-09 — Design critique: recommend color palette for confidence (amber/green/red) accessible at AA contrast. Replace modal-heavy diff lens with an anchored slide-over so engineers keep context.

2025-11-10 — Prototype update: interactive Figma prototype linked; included payload diff view for JSON responses and token-highlight example for text generation failures. Added copy for suggested mitigations derived from correlation (e.g., 'Model X.2 accounted for 87% of failures in cluster; consider rollback to X.1 if regression confirmed').
2025-11-11 — PM/Eng alignment: agreed release target console-2025.11 for an alpha behind feature flag for internal SREs. Eng dependency list updated.
2025-11-12 — Next steps: usability testing with 3 SREs next week, engineering spike to validate perf impact of on-demand token diffs, finalize copy and microcopy for quick actions.
